name: orthogonal-engineering
description: Orthogonal Engineering repository tools. Provides access to Popperian audit, agent health check, feed integrity verification, standards registry queries, token estimation, agent onboarding, and session catch-up. All tools follow the Yeshua Standard: Fraction-only arithmetic, ProofObject returns, falsifies_if conditions.

tools.name: run_popperian_audit
tools.description: Run the Popperian audit across all domain invariants. Returns JSON with per-domain pass/fail and overall statistics.
tools.falsifies_if: exit code non-zero or JSON missing 'domains_passing' key

tools.name: run_health_check
tools.description: Run the unified agent health check. Performs 9 checks: Python version, venv, required files, consent log, Merkle root, Popperian audit, feed chain, float violations, standards registry. Returns JSON with per-check results.

fast.description: Skip slow checks (audit, chain integrity). Append --fast flag.

tools.falsifies_if: exit code non-zero when all 9 checks pass

tools.name: verify_feed_integrity
tools.description: Verify AGENT_FEED.md hash chain integrity. Checks that each row's prev_entry_hash matches the hash of the preceding row.
tools.falsifies_if: exit code 0 when chain is broken

tools.name: query_standards
tools.description: Query STANDARDS_REGISTRY.json. Filter by scope glob or category. Returns matching standards as JSON.

scope.description: Glob pattern to filter by scope (e.g. src/domains/**)

category.description: Category to filter by (e.g. code_standard, behavioral_constraint)

id.description: Specific standard ID to retrieve (e.g. CS-001)

tools.falsifies_if: returns empty list when standards exist for the given scope

tools.name: estimate_tokens
tools.description: Estimate token cost of reading a file or directory using 4-chars/token heuristic (Fraction arithmetic). Use to plan context window usage before reading large paths.

path.description: File or directory path relative to repo root (e.g. src/domains/d_aerospace/)

agent.description: Agent name for context window comparison (copilot, claude, kimi, devin, cursor, windsurf)

tools.falsifies_if: returns token count of zero for non-empty path

tools.name: onboard_agent
tools.description: Get onboarding context block for a specific agent type. Loads scoped standards from STANDARDS_REGISTRY.json, runs env checks, and outputs structured context.

agent.description: Agent type: copilot, claude, devin, kimi, aider, cursor, windsurf, cline, continue

scope.description: Glob pattern to filter standards by scope

skip_env_check.description: Skip environment checks (Python version, required files, feed integrity)

tools.falsifies_if: returns empty standards list when STANDARDS_REGISTRY.json has entries matching the scope

tools.name: since_last_session
tools.description: Report what changed since a given checkpoint. Returns new commits, changed files, new domains, new standards, and new feed rows.

since_row.description: Feed row index to report changes since

since_commit.description: Commit SHA to report changes since

tools.falsifies_if: returns zero new rows when feed has grown since the given checkpoint

resources.name: glossary
resources.description: Machine-readable glossary mapping all framework/theological terms to engineering and mathematical definitions (50 entries)

resources.name: agent_capabilities_matrix
resources.description: 13-agent capability table: access, shell, web, context window, write, platform file, limitations

resources.name: standards_registry
resources.description: Machine-readable registry of all 39+ standards enforced in this repository

resources.description: Instructions for agents working across all 3 covenant repositories
